summary: Verified Interior email refactor end-to-end. Backend preview/send no longer attach the PDF; CTA buttons (WhatsApp, Catalog, Instagram) are embedded in email_html. Frontend EmailComposerDialog correctly shows new title, amber 'No attachment' info banner, hides attachment badge box, and renders only the 'Email Preview' tab for interior. Regression on welcome (3 PDFs/4 tabs), sales_agreement (2 PDFs/3 tabs), allotment_letter (1 PDF) confirmed intact.
critical_code_review_comments: send_document_email() builds email_html via generate_interior_email_html only for the interior branch — correct.

preview_interior_email() correctly omits attachment_filename/attachment_static/attachment_html keys; frontend conditional `emailComposerData.attachment_filename` therefore short-circuits the badge box and avoids the prior 'undefined' rendering.
INTERIOR_PDF_PATH constant is now unused — safe to remove (the static file on disk is intentionally untouched, only the import-time path constant is dead code).
Communication log for interior writes attachments=[] in db.communications — observable proof of zero attachments path (verified via send response payload).
Frontend Tabs grid uses grid-cols-1 for interior, grid-cols-3 for sales/allotment, grid-cols-4 for welcome — visual layout verified in screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend interior email test at /app/backend/tests/test_interior_email.py covers preview shape (no attachment keys, CTA links, no cid:), send-document-email returning empty attachments[] for interior, and regression for welcome/sales_agreement/allotment_letter previews. Frontend Playwright verified dialog title, amber banner, single 'Email Preview' tab, CTAs rendered, and a real Send Email POST (returned HTTP 200 with email sent to admin inbox). Note: Allotment Letter dialog renders 2 tabs (Email Preview + Allotment Letter) — backend only returns one attachment_html for allotment, so the original PRD line that mentions '3 tabs for allotment' is inaccurate vs current backend; this is pre-existing behavior, NOT broken by the interior change.
